function _lllIOIIO.curved(b, now)

    pcall(function() if _01lI1I.handle then task.cancel(_01lI1I.handle) _01lI1I.handle = nil end end)
    if not _OII1l1 then return end
    _OII1l1 = false
    for _, c in ipairs(_IIIOOllO) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    table.clear(_lOIll0) table.clear(_IOOII0O)
    _IO01I0lO0() pcall(_OI0lOll01)
    pcall(_0l0Ol11O.unhook)
    pcall(function() if _0l0Ol11O.signal then _0l0Ol11O.signal:Destroy() end end)
    pcall(function() _1I0OlI.FPSBoost(false) end)
    pcall(function() if _0I0l1l and workspace.CurrentCamera then workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = 70 end end)
    pcall(function() if _10O1OOO and _O100I1Oll then for k, v in pairs(_O100I1Oll) do _110IllO[k] = v end end end)
    pcall(function() _01ll01:Destroy() end)
end

local _lO10IO00l = nil
_1I0OlI.FPSBoost = function(v)
    if v then
        if _lO10IO00l then return end
        local st = {parts = {}}
        _lO10IO00l = st
        pcall(function() st.quality = settings().Rendering.QualityLevel end)
        pcall(function() settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01 end)
        st.shadows = _110IllO.GlobalShadows
        _110IllO.GlobalShadows = false
        task.spawn(function()
            local n = 0
            for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if not _OII1l1 or _lO10IO00l ~= st then return end
                if d:IsA(_OOllOI01l(1012)) or d:IsA(_OOllOI01l(1013)) or d:IsA(_OOllOI01l(1014)) or d:IsA(_OOllOI01l(1015)) or d:IsA(_OOllOI01l(1016)) then
                    if d.Enabled then d.Enabled = false table.insert(st.parts, d) end
                end
                n = n + 1
                if n % 400 == 0 then task.wait() end
            end
        end)
    else
        local st = _lO10IO00l
        if not st then return end
        _lO10IO00l = nil
        pcall(function() if st.quality then settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = st.quality end end)
        pcall(function() _110IllO.GlobalShadows = st.shadows end)
        for _, d in ipairs(st.parts) do pcall(function() d.Enabled = true end) end
    end
end
